summary: National Healthcare Properties, Inc. (NHP) filed an 8-K disclosing an unsolicited mini-tender offer by MacKenzie Capital Management, LP for up to 150,000 common shares (≈0.2% of outstanding) at $7.27/share. The board determined to make no recommendation and remain neutral. The offer is below the market? No premium stated; typical mini-tender risks (low price, no withdrawal rights). The company published a letter to stockholders advising caution. Watch for NHP's defensive response and SEC guidance on mini-tenders.
